set.pl: Patrick Rowland patent block, E½ sec. 2 / W½ sec. 1 T21N R10W, Town of Glencoe (Buffalo Co.), about six miles from Arcadia
set.t: His hut stood on his own land about six miles from Arcadia, near a vacant schoolhouse; in 1893 "no one knows where his money is hidden." Find the hut site and the old schoolhouse on the 1888 Buffalo plat and 1938 aerial. His grave is look-only. Access: private: permission.
pinev: Patrick Rowland's ~600-acre patent block (E½ sec 2 / W½ sec 1 T21N R10W; BLM patents 1865-76); same name (Roland/Rowland), same town
Milwaukee Sentinel 19 Nov 1893 puts his hut six miles from Arcadia, which fits the block

tw-wi-glencoe-roland-1893.st: A separate Arcadia dispatch (Milwaukee Sentinel, 19 Nov 1893) puts his hut six miles from Arcadia with a vacant schoolhouse nearby, and says "no one knows where his money is hidden."
